justifications.patch-os-03: Redgum has no internet-facing servers or network devices. All externally reachable services are SaaS operated by the vendor.
justifications.patch-os-05: No internet-facing servers or network devices to patch.
justifications.patch-os-06: No internet-facing servers or network devices to patch.
justifications.mfa-04: Redgum has no online customer services. Customers book by phone and email; there is no customer-facing portal.
justifications.mfa-05: No third-party online customer services are used. Customer contact is by phone and email only.
justifications.mfa-06: No online customer services exist, so there are no customers to authenticate.
justifications.mfa-11: No online customer services exist, so there is no customer authentication to make phishing-resistant.
justifications.mfa-15: No internet-facing servers, so no event logs from them exist.
justifications.mfa-21: No online customer services exist, so there is no customer authentication to make phishing-resistant.
justifications.patch-apps-02: Redgum does not run its own scanner. Its managed service provider runs authenticated vulnerability scanning against an up-to-date database under the support contract and supplies monthly reports, which Redgum reviews and retains.
